old_title: Cathedrals of sound: the secret universe inside musical instruments - in pictures
new_title: Cathedrals of sound: the secret universe inside musical instruments - in pictures
old_text: Photographer and former cellist Charles Brooks creates optical illusions with minuscule cameras. He threads endoscopes inside instruments to capture thousands of images which are then combined: a clarinet becomes a dark tunnel, a yidaki becomes a cave, a Steinway piano is a futuristic train station: 'You're also looking inside the history of these instruments ... All the marks you're seeing are from them being cleaned or repaired, or by the maker themselves'
